task: Pin the Narwhal IDP Portal image to the published release 1.1.9 (was 1.1.8); the repository change is static and no cluster rollout was performed.

events.summary: Tag bump of one image in the GitOps manifest, its air-gap inventory and digest pin, the docs that quote the pin, and the committed OSS-updates snapshot regenerated by gen-oss-versions.mjs. No manifest structure, env, RBAC or chart change. No merge, no Gitea push and no cluster rollout in this change.

ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.1.9 was published from tag portal/v1.1.9 on ca78d0ee (#607): the Portal Release workflow completed successfully. Checked 2026-11-08T15:46:00Z: the tag resolves to index digest sha256:72a1f4f4adda77d96258ab1981f67b500f3072f8cedec598ec6f8a17d8d295cc and cosign verify with scripts/airgap/keys/cosign.pub passes on it. Local Vagrant nodes pull ghcr.io directly; a cluster whose nodes cannot reach ghcr.io must mirror by digest first (scripts/airgap/README.md, Mirror a pin bump).

Pin moved 1.1.8 -> 1.1.9 in the Deployment image, images.txt and image-digests.tsv (new digest), gitops README pins and prose (en/ko), VERSIONS.md (IDP Portal row), compatibility-matrix, SECURITY.md example and the Unreleased changelog entries (en/ko); portal/src/data/oss-versions.generated.json regenerated with gen-oss-versions.mjs. 1.1.9 bumps lucide-react to 1.66.0 (#539) and lists the skopeo image in the OSS versions list (#603); no user-facing feature change.
Local static checks only; no live cluster verification was run for this pin.
